usd_reason: The Fed is likely to continue raising interest rates to address inflation, which will strengthen the US dollar
gold_reason: Higher interest rates typically reduce demand for gold as investors seek higher returns from other assets

lead_story: The upcoming inflation report is the biggest macro driver right now, with the Fed expected to raise interest rates if inflation remains high. The report will be closely watched by investors and policymakers. A high inflation reading could lead to further rate hikes, impacting the entire economy.
